meta.datasetTh: โรงเรียนและสถานศึกษาในประเทศไทย
meta.readMethod: the sheet's HTML view read cell by cell in the owner's browser (scripts/export-sheet-tabs.js); SHA-256 of each tab's rows as canonical JSON

unit.row: one CityMETER school UUID of the 2026 baseline (02_SCHOOLS or 03_CHILD_CENTERS) — a source roster record, not a field-verified census of operating schools
unit.students: student_count of CityMETER 2026, positive values only; blank is unknown, never 0; a child development centre counts its registered children
unit.fee: annual tuition in THB per student per academic year, tuition only, for the grades and year the school published; not the total cost of a year, a price level or a quality level
unit.quality: the latest ONESQA external-assessment result the sheet selected (B.E. 2564–2567), verbatim, with its year; not a current quality level or a ranking
unit.history: the reported grade sum of OPEC private-school snapshots, semesters 1–2 of B.E. 2565–2567; not 2026 figures

adminMethods.source: the production district the source lists the school under
adminMethods.name: the row's district name is a production district of its province

meta.districts: CityMETER production base info (lv0/lv1, receipts in data/boundary-receipts.json) + district outlines of data/frames/{CODE}.json

points.rule: the sheet's point where coordinate_status passed the extent check (ONESQA or OPEC registry point, not an entrance)

rail.rule: operating = on the operator roster of CityMETER · Transit; construction = a project station, not a service; straight-line distance from the school point to the station reference point, up to 2000 m

notes: Distances to rail stations are straight-line distances between reference points.
A gap (no tuition, no assessment result, no history) is not a low value or a free school: most rows have not been researched for it.
